title: Prepare transfers large payloads without shell argv
description: Use a disposable authenticated gateway, real files and Bash, with substituted tmux transport. Transfer a 1.5 MiB diff through normal prepare and the existing node file API. No product slot or real tmux server.

prepare.intent: The actual prepare path preserves large diff bytes while exec commands stay small, and the node file API preserves the same bytes and mode.
